items.title: Chain Letter (ABC 1989) - pilot
items.description:
Of all the television pilots out there, this is my #1 (2001’s reboot of Electra Woman & Dyna Girl with Markie Post is a close second).

Chain Letter is a pilot from 1989 that never made it to series. It aired on ABC on 8/5/89.
